This page details the installation and usage of the MATLAB&reg; version of the PropLib implementation of the IF-77 Electromagnetic Wave Propagation Model.

{{< include /includes/_link_to_model_home.qmd >}}

## Getting Started

This MATLAB&reg; Toolbox is distributed on [MathWorks&reg; File Exchange](#TODO).

{{< include /includes/matlab/_getting_started.qmd >}}

{{< include /includes/matlab/_documentation.qmd >}}

```matlab
help ITS.Propagation.IF77.IF77Model

% Prints detailed usage information!
```

{{< include /includes/matlab/_examples.qmd >}}

### Calling the IF77 Model

```matlab
import ITS.Propagation.IF77.*

% Define inputs
if77_card1 = IF77Card1();      % IF77Card1 input class
if77_card2 = IF77Card2();      % IF77Card2 input class
if77_card3 = IF77Card3();      % IF77Card3 input class

if77_card1.output_type = Enums.Output.TransmissionLoss;
if77_card1.lobing_flag = Enums.Lobing.NoLobing;
if77_card1.time_availability_flag = Enums.TimeAvailability.InstantaneousLevels;
if77_card1.d__km = 119.3048129015685;
if77_card1.percentage = 50;

if77_card2.h_1__meter = 292.10976985787516;
if77_card2.antenna_1_pattern = Enums.AntennaPattern.Isotropic;
if77_card2.antenna_1_use = Enums.AntennaUse.Directive;
if77_card2.antenna_1_polarization = Enums.AntennaPolarization.Vertical;
if77_card2.antenna_1_tilt__deg = 0;
if77_card2.antenna_1_half_half_beamwidth__deg = 0;
if77_card2.h_fss__meter = 242.10976985787516;
if77_card2.rainfall_zone = Enums.RainfallZone.NoRainfall;
if77_card2.storm_size = Enums.StormSize.FiveKm;
if77_card2.terrain_type = Enums.TerrainType.IrregularTerrain;
if77_card2.horizon_input = Enums.HorizonInput.Height;
if77_card2.delta_h__meter = 290.8360817429317;
if77_card2.d_hzn__km = 5.8102343919372412;
if77_card2.h_hzn__meter = 471;
if77_card2.low_horizon_angle_degrees = 1;
if77_card2.low_horizon_angle_minutes = 44;
if77_card2.low_horizon_angle_seconds = 27;
if77_card2.counterpoise_diameter__meter = 0;
if77_card2.counterpoise_height__meter = 0;
if77_card2.counterpoise_material = Enums.Material.None;

if77_card3.h_2__meter = 120000;
if77_card3.antenna_2_pattern = Enums.AntennaPattern.Isotropic;
if77_card3.antenna_2_use = Enums.AntennaUse.Directive;
if77_card3.antenna_2_polarization = Enums.AntennaPolarization.Vertical;
if77_card3.antenna_2_tilt__deg = 0;
if77_card3.antenna_2_half_half_beamwidth__deg = 0;
if77_card3.N_0 = 315;
if77_card3.f__mhz = 3000;
if77_card3.eirp = 0;
if77_card3.h_sur__meter = 284;
if77_card3.path_material = Enums.Material.AverageGround;
if77_card3.water_temp__celsius = Enums.Temperature.TenDegreesCelsius;
if77_card3.water_wave_height = 0;
if77_card3.water_state = Enums.WaterState.CalmGlassy;
if77_card3.path_water_wave_height_use_flag = Enums.WaterWaveHeight.UseStandard;
if77_card3.scintillation_index_group = Enums.ScintillationIndex.IndexGroup1;
if77_card3.scintillation_freq_scaling = Enums.FrequencyScaling.None;
if77_card3.scintillation_use_flag = Enums.ScintillationUse.NoScintillation;
if77_card3.climate_1 = Enums.Climate.ContinentalAllYear;
if77_card3.weight_1 = 0;
if77_card3.climate_2 = Enums.Climate.ContinentalAllYear;
if77_card3.weight_2 = 0;

% Call the IF77 model
if77_result = IF77(if77_card1, if77_card2, if77_card3);
disp(if77_result);

% The provided inputs should approximately result in:
% IF77Result with properties:
%                 warnings: 0
%   takeoff_angle__degrees: 40.8568
%         propagation_mode: LineOfSight
%                 A_fs__db: 146.5910
%                    A__db: -146.6341
```

### Calling the IF77 Extended Model

The inputs for IF77 Extended Model are the same as IF77 Model shown above. The outputs include the terminals and path information in addition to IF77 model results.

```
% Call the IF77 extended model
[if77_result, if77_terminal1, if77_terminal2, if77_path] = IF77_Ex(if77_card1, if77_card2, if77_card3);
disp(if77_result);
disp(if77_terminal1);
disp(if77_terminal2);
disp(if77_path);

% The provided inputs should approximately result in:
% IF77Result with properties:
%                 warnings: 0
%   takeoff_angle__degrees: 40.8568
%         propagation_mode: LineOfSight
%                 A_fs__db: 146.5910
%                    A__db: -146.6341

% IF77Terminal with properties:
%             h__km: 0.2921
%           h_r__km: 0.2921
%           h_e__km: 0.0081
%          h_rs__km: 0.0081
%       delta_h__km: 0
%             d__km: 11.7889
%           d_r__km: 11.9355
%         d_hzn__km: 5.8102
%      theta_r__rad: 0.0014
%    theta_ray__rad: 0.0014
%    theta_hzn__rad: 0.0304
%     theta_TO__rad: -0.0311
%           z_e__km: 8.5686e+03

% IF77Terminal with properties:
%             h__km: 99.5949
%           h_r__km: 120
%           h_e__km: 99.3109
%          h_rs__km: 119.7160
%       delta_h__km: 20.4051
%             d__km: 1.2983e+03
%           d_r__km: 1.2983e+03
%         d_hzn__km: 1.0725e+03
%      theta_r__rad: 0.1515
%    theta_ray__rad: 0.1908
%    theta_hzn__rad: -0.1932
%     theta_TO__rad: 0.0311
%           z_e__km: 8.6679e+03

% IF77Path with properties:
%                h_sur__km: 0.2840
%                h_fss__km: 0.2421
%               h_1fss__km: 0.0500
%                h_hzn__km: 0.4710
%                 d_ML__km: 1.0783e+03
%                    d__km: 119.3048
%                  d_0__km: 1.0483e+03
%                  d_d__km: 1.0483e+03
%           psi_limit__rad: 0.0032
%              delta_h__km: 0.2908
%                      N_0: 315
%                      N_s: 305.6846
%            material_enum: AverageGround
%                    sigma: 0.0050
%                  epsilon: 15
%                  a_e__km: 8.5686e+03
%      water_temp__celsius: 10
%    use_user_sigma_h_flag: UseStandard
%             user_sigma_h: 0
%              water_state: CalmGlassy
%                   lobing: NoLobing
%                 psi__rad: 0.7132
%             terrain_type: IrregularTerrain
```
